changelog:
- Initial release of Etsy category page scraping skill.
- Given an Etsy category URL (and optional page number), returns paginated product listings with detailed fields (listingId, shopId, title, url, image, prices, shopName, and more).
- Handles pagination and extraction from both category and subcategory pages.
- Includes error handling for anti-bot protection and loading issues.
- Designed for use cases like trend research, competitor benchmarking, and bulk data collection within Etsy categories.
